description: smoke job env sets RETRIEVAL_MIN_SCORE out of [0, 1]
find:
name: Import & route smoke tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
replace:
name: Import & route smoke tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RETRIEVAL_MIN_SCORE: "1.5"
notes: The value is a valid float, so the import step passes and pytest runs: 1 failed, 12 passed. Same failing test and same log output as inj-009: pytest prints 'assert 1.5 <= 1.0' with the Settings repr (retrieval_min_score=1.5), identical to inj-009. The pytest output cannot tell an environment override from a changed code default; only the diff (ci.yml env block here vs api/utils/config.py in inj-009) distinguishes environment from real_regression. GitHub prints job-level env in the 'env:' block of each step header, so the log also shows 'RETRIEVAL_MIN_SCORE: 1.5' above the failing step. That line is not part of the pytest output, but it is in the job log.
